title: Release cadence one-pager: standup + go/no-go prep
content:
Purpose and audience:
- Quick one-pager for my personal prep before the weekly release cadence standup.
- Audience: Release owners, SRE lead, ML infra, PM. Keep it short for read-ahead.

Meeting goals (30m):
- Align owners on final go/no-go criteria for the upcoming ship window.
- Surface any last-minute blockers and owners.
- Confirm smoke test windows and rollback triggers.
- Assign immediate follow-ups and owner handoffs for the push window.

Top-line status (my read):
- Build: green on CI, last deploy verified to staging at 03/09 18:20 PT.
- Canary: 2h stable on dedicated pool, latency + error rate within thresholds.
- Data migration: small schema tweak queued, migration window planned during push (owner: Marco).
- Docs/customer comms: draft ready, waiting legal ack (owner: Claire).

Go/No-Go checklist (quick yes/no owners):
- Critical tests passing (unit/integration/smoke) — owner: QA lead (yes).
- Canaries within latency SLO (p99 < benchmark) — owner: SRE (wait/yes).
- DB migration prepared and rollback script available — owner: Marco Jensen (needs final check).
- Model pin/version confirmed and small-sample eval complete — owner: ML infra (Aisha to confirm).
- Monitoring dashboards live + alerts smoke-tested — owner: Observability (yes).
- Legal/PII signoff on tracking changes — owner: Claire Nguyen (pending).
- Customer comms queued in Intercom/Status page — owner: PM (drafted).

Risk register (short):
- Risk: DB migration contention causing slow queries. Mitigation: lock-free migration strategy; rollback plan prepared.
- Risk: Canary model regression (quality). Mitigation: auto-fallback to previous model variant + holdback routing.
- Risk: Unexpected tokenization changes impacting outputs. Mitigation: preflight example set run in staging; manual check by ML lead.

Smoke test plan & owners (this doc is my cheat-sheet):
- 15m pre-push smoke (end-to-end happy path): SRE + QA.
- 30m canary burn-in (low-traffic routes): traffic ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% if stable. Owner: SRE + Serving runtime.
- Latency bench (p50/p95/p99): Observability to verify; thresholds captured in Confluence page.
- Cost/throughput check post-deploy: infra metrics owner to snapshot.

Rollback indicators (if any true -> immediate rollback):
- Error rate > 3x baseline for 5m
- P99 latency > SLO by 30% for 10m
- Data migration partial failure (inconsistent schema state)
- Model quality drop on golden prompts (manual check)

My personal prompts / 1:1 ask list (notes to self to raise during meeting):
- Ask SRE: confirm exact canary traffic shift timeline and who will press the ramp controls.
- Ask Marco: confirm migration dry-run succeeded and runbook location. Get commit hash.
- Ask Claire: ballpark for legal turnaround if she can't unblock before push — do we delay or proceed with limited feature set?
- Confirm with PM whether there are any enterprise customers on extendedalpha list to notify pre-push.

Action items (to assign during standup, my suggested owners):
- Finalize migration runbook and attach to release page — owner: Marco (due: 2026-03-11 10:00 PT).
- Smoke-test checklist sign-off (signed screenshot of dashboards) — owner: Observability (due: 2026-03-11 12:00 PT).
- Legal signoff or scoped exception — owner: Claire (due: 2026-03-11 14:00 PT).
- Prepare rollback step-by-step script for on-call — owner: SRE (due: 2026-03-11 15:00 PT).
- Notify extendedalpha customers with ETA and post-window contact — owner: PM (due: 2026-03-11 16:00 PT).

Personal quick win list (if nothing major shows up):
- Push updated example prompts to the public eval set.
- Add a single note in the release page about expected transient tokenization change.
- Confirm that model pin PR is merged and tag created.

Open questions I want to surface:
- Do we have an agreed SLA for the dedicated pool if we need hot failover? (Cost impact?)
- If legal can't sign off, can we ship with tracking disabled? Impact on metrics?
- Any outstanding infra quotas in the EU region that could throttle the canary?

Meeting cadence reminders for me:
- Pre-standup 30m: quick sync with Marco (migration readiness).
- Standup: read the two-line TL;DR and call out any blocking legal/migration items early.
- Post-standup 15m: update release page with decisions + owner names and times.

Notes to self after the meeting (template):
- Decision made: [GO/NO-GO]
- Immediate blockers: [list]
- Action owners + due times: [list]
- Follow-up 1:1s scheduled: [names/times]

Misc links (for quick paste in chat):
- Release page: CONFLUENCE/release/cadence-2026-q1
- Migration runbook (draft): JIRA-RLS-2378
- Model pin PR: GH-PR-821-model-pin

Hand-off script (for oncall):
- If canary stable for 30m -> proceed to 100% ramp.
- If rollback indicator triggered -> execute rollback_runbook_v1, notify #release-ops, escalate to SRE.

Quick personal checklist before I sit down:
- [ ] Confirm attend list for standup.
- [ ] Sync with Marco 30m prior.
- [ ] Grab latest canary metrics screenshot.
- [ ] Ensure legal has read the short summary (ping Claire).

---
This is a personal working draft — will tidy after standup and push the finalized decisions to the release confluence page.
